origin.description: Pad a styled string to a width, counting only visible characters.
origin.usage: col_align(text, width = getOption("width"), align = c("left", "center", "right"), type = "width")

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: Field width. The default is the width option.

arguments.name: align
arguments.text: "left", "center", or "right". A unique prefix is enough.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Passed to col_nchar() and from there to nchar().

origin.details: Padding is spaces. A field narrower than the text is returned without extra spaces. Center splits the spare columns with ceiling on the left and floor on the right.
origin.example:
cat(col_align(red("foobar"), 20, "left"), "
", sep="")
cat(col_align(red("foobar"), 20, "center"), "
", sep="")
cat(col_align(red("foobar"), 20, "right"), "
", sep="")

translation.description: Pad a styled string to a width, counting only visible characters.

arguments.name: text
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: Field width. None uses the width option, default 80.

translation.details: Spaces are added around the styled string. The count uses col_nchar, so the ANSI codes do not eat the padding.
translation.value: The aligned string, or a list.
